A Half Gram of Pure Disappointment - MDMA Immunity
TL;DR: In short, this is the true telling of an individual who is seemingly resistant to the effects of MDMA, even at very high doses. An oddity is the report as you'll read is actually more reporting a lack of a high than it is an experience of having successfully gotten high off of MDMA. Apologies in advance for any tense and/or head-hopping confusion.
Medications/interactions/external variables:
40mg Fluoxetine
2mg Lorazepam
100mg Buproprion
Preface I: Ive read experience reports since I was a kid, always enthusiastic and determined to learn more about drugs and their effects on the human consciousness. Now, here I am, left with no option but to write my own!
I am and have for the past several days been absolute bewildered and perplexed as to the following. I desperately want to know what is going on.
Preface II: I understand that reading this, the main reaction from anyone would understandably be well, he certainly wasnt doing MDMA. Let me assure you, I was skeptical myself, so we tested it, and it isnt just MDMA but very high purity MDMA. A big fat 3 gram off-white/brownish crystalline rock. A truly beautiful specimen. I remarked upon first seeing it how incredible it looks, how I could imagine shining it into an Opal-esque gem. At first it was microdosing and working our way up. My friends didnt even want to take any because of how theyd be up all night - it was indeed quite late at this point so understandably I let them be and chipped off some MDMA to ingest on my own. I was so excited as I only had heard the tales of extreme pleasure and euphoria that MDMA brings.
Id gotten a taste of true euphoria on Mushrooms, LSD, DMT, and sadly to group these in with the former but as well as on heroin, and on oxycodone (years ago before it was impossible to find anything thats not fentanyl) - all in different ways but that feeling that I can only describe to the drug-uninitiated as absolutely orgasmic. Not just mental euphoria, if that is a thing, I believe this distinction is important. Im talking about the physical feeling of waves of pleasure coursing throughout your entire body. Ive even done meth once or twice, and my fair share of cocaine. Perhaps I am the one using the word euphoria wrong, but Ill say: one could mistake the word euphoria for the total awesome feeling on cocaine or meth. Ive gotten very high off of all these drugs, but never experienced euphoria from cocaine or meth like I can say I did with heroin, oxy, and at peaks of trips on psychedelics like DMT, LSD, and psilocybin. Those latter few all have their differences but when I say, incorrectly or otherwise, euphoric I mean specifically the physical feeling of absolute pleasure, what I mean when I say euphoric I mean to say is very much like a prolonged orgasm state. Pleasure in every fiber of your skin and drop of your blood.
So, suffice it to say I was excited to get a taste of MDMA's much spoken about euphoria once and for all! I take .1g, then .15 more after 45 minutes. I ask my friends if I should be feeling it yet, and they both agreed I should definitely be feeling it. Time went on, and Id keep chipping away at the rock and swallowing more and more MDMA, trying different techniques on how Im ingesting it, changing all possible variables to get an accurate controlled answer. As time went on, and my disappointment grew, I was certain this was bunk. We bought a Reagent Test Kit, as well as another Meth/MDMA test kit, smoked some weed, and called it a night. The next day, there was zero hangover, it was simply as if I hadnt taken anything at all the previous day. I decided I would do more MDMA to get to the bottom of this.
A few days later, I go back to my friends house and we are joking all about how this isnt Molly but Folly (2-in-1 joke for fake Molly and the term Folly). I throw some MDMA down the hatch because Id done it that previous time and felt absolutely nothing. No good, no bad, just nothing, the absence of a high. At this point, bewildered as I am, I am still feeling confident that this at least certainly wasnt something dirty, knowing that I would indeed be Feeling it although a different, much worse, it had the drug I ingested been some kind of dirty molly.
I test the Molly, first with the cheaper MDMA/Meth kit; which told us that its definitely MDMA/Ecstacy/METH, and while it was nice to know that this is in fact A DRUG, and a stimulating one, whichever of the three, and not just some random crystalline rock from the local Quartz dealer. But the test did not tell us what exactly it was, which of the three; simply that is indeed one of the three. We both found that test we just did so useless we couldnt help but burst out laughing. I let my friends help me and we get the reagent test done. It isnt any Folly, it is pure and high grade MDMA. So, why wasnt I getting high off of it? Surely I just wasnt taking enough then, and my friends were wrong, Erowid was wrong, everyone was wrong. One of my friends takes a .1 and soon after cant stop talking about how hard hes rolling face. What the fuck? Was God playing a joke on me? Reader, dont be confused, my friend and I are the same size, nothing peculiar or Id of mentioned it, except of course that he did not take the same meds as me, though I do know he takes Strattera daily.
So there I am feeling zero effects and beginning to succumb to the thinking that my medications could very well indeed be totally inhibiting any reaction from the MDMA
I am feeling zero effects and beginning to succumb to the thinking that my medications could very well indeed be totally inhibiting any reaction from the MDMA
, I stupidly ("stupidly," because of how risky this stuff is, in general, with your heart, etc.) decide to take an amount that would certainly blow the doors off even a well sedated person, I was going to take an amount that would answer my curiosity, irrefutably, whether this shit could get me high or not, whether I am just immune to MDMA, due to medication, or otherwise. I chop the remaining amount of the rock more or less in half, and decide Id swallow a giant chunk that anyone could just look at and not just see that it was enough Molly to give someone a great night partying, but enough for that as well as five more. An obviously, comically so perhaps, large dose of Molly for a first (second) timer. Parachute it goes, down the hatch.
Thirty minutes pass, and the only thing I feel is a growing worry that MDMA will indeed not bring me any high at all. An hour, two, three hours later, my buddy and his friend/dealer are laughing and bewildered as well, but making half-jokes that sooner or later I am going to feel absolutely all of it at once and not be able to function. But no, I wish I could say that was the case. I ended up consuming *well* more than 500mg of MDMA that night.  I dont feel euphoric, I dont feel high, hell I dont even feel methy, wired, or weird in any way - other than that I should be rolling face - and I am not. It wasnt the rocks fault, it wasnt the dealers fault, it wasnt the MDMAs fault, it was MY fault. All I felt was disappointment. Any yearning to do more has been, as far as I can tell, not out of the drugs effects, but from the true curiosity that was left in place of any effect at all.
What high can I report? Well, strangely enough, only a lack thereof one! Can I just be "immune" to the effects of MDMA somehow? Is that even possible?
Today, I spoke to both my psychiatrist and psychologist. I see separate doctors for my therapy and my medication often. We had some decent conversations, but I was let down in hearing that neither my medication prescriber, nor my therapist
, thought that this was to do with the effects of Wellbutrin or Fluoxetine. And I know my benzos, we all agreed that even under my current regimen, there isnt any clear reason at all for why the MDMA didnt blow the doors off the hinges - at any dose. I was actually told I should read online for any similar reports, of which I sadly cannot find. Perhaps my doctors, and myself, are totally wrong, and the medications are completely incompatible with being able to feel high, in any form whether it be speedy, empathetic, methy, from MDMA. Perhaps it is my brain - or all of these in conjunction with my brain. Perhaps we wont have any answer for a long time to come.
One doctor did admit something personal and interesting to me. He prefaced it with how he has and never has had any real interest in THC (he resides and practices in a legal state) but that he himself could take as many THC edibles as he wants and feel zero effect. Guess what reader? I am similarly immune - resistant, rather - to the effects of edibles. Once, over a decade ago, one time, I did edibles and got incredibly out-of-this-world high. I am a daily pot smoker, dab taker, cart vaper, but Ive since done enough edibles of all different kinds and potencies from all different sources, and never again could I get high from edibles, to this day. I almost want to snort MDMA thinking this could be some kind of digestive/gastrointestinal  problem, but at this point, Ive really been beating the fuck out of a dead horse for way too long. I wont give up like my docs advised, I will continue to pursue a clear answer, in the hopes that there is some usefulness to someone down the line in similar shoes. Hence why I am writing this post here right now. Apologies for the poor and excessive writing, Ive never been a strong writer, but hopefully this is legible enough to deduce reasonably what I am trying to communicate. Id like to understand just what the hell is going on! For over a decade I had only been lucky enough to hear a few war stories about how good MDMA feels, now in possession of certain, pure MDMA, only to find that Lady Feels wont show up for me!
Thanks for reading, hopefully one day I can write a sequel to this report in which I write my report of physical surges of euphoria raining down from the MDMA Heavens.
